sources.quote: 18 Delphini, also named Musica, is a binary star in the constellation of Delphinus of the low northern hemisphere.

introduction.text: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 34 times the Sun's luminosity at 5,020 K, so 7.775 solar radii.
